import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the visual style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to explore the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep, colored by Gender
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', 
                                size='Daily Steps', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.6, palette='deep')

# Add titles and labels
scatter_plot.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Gender', fontsize=12, title_fontsize='13')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
